instruction: Lindsey has asked me for my weekly workout plan over email. I have drafted a reply to it. Please export my workout plan note from Simple Note to a text file, attach it to the draft, and send the email.
notes: Four apps: supervisor, simple_note, file_system, gmail. Flow: read passwords; log into Simple Note, search for the workout plan note and read its content; log into the file system and export the content to a new .txt file (file-created records the exact content, as the attachment content must match the note); log into Gmail, locate the existing reply draft to Lindsey via show_drafts (verified with show_draft as a reply to Lindsey), upload the exported file as an attachment (needs both gmail and file_system tokens), then send the email from the draft. Sending requires the draft to already carry the attachment so the planner cannot send first. No new draft or email is created and nothing is updated/deleted, matching the evaluation (only one attachment, one sent email, the draft consumed). supervisor-complete-task takes the draft/file/content task records (not API arguments) so its precondition can state the goal; it has no answer since the task is not a question.
